## Checklist
1. Pick an existing deposit recipe id and deposit block in `kubejs/server_scripts/main.js`
2. Remove the built-in recipe and register your replacement in `kubejs/server_scripts/main.js`
3. Adjust yields, catalysts, durability, and dimension to match your pack

Default built-in mining recipe ids can be found in `src/generated/builtin_packs/default/create_rns_dynamic_data/data/create_rns/recipe`
